evidence_quotes.section1_quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'it will take about ten minutes' but never frames a dependable quote promise or waits for a yes before continuing. Immediately shifts to 'let's go ahead and create a profile.'
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Moving day (Friday), type (two-bedroom apartment), route (within Austin area) asked, but customer name for the move not clearly confirmed—profile registered under Daisy (the caller), not the actual customer.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep jumps directly into logistics probing without 'what are your biggest concerns about this move?' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer, so no follow-up opportunity existed.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns raised to reflect back.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Covered: property type (apartment), floor (first floor), rooms (two bedroom), walking distance (hallway, close). Partially covered: no exact square footage given (rep assumed 900 sq ft); boxes asked but customer didn't have firm count initially (later provided 30–50 boxes). Missing: additional stops (drop-off location confirmed, but no mention of intermediate stops or special considerations like elevators).
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not asked. No version of 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?' appears in the transcript.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Asked, but indirectly: 'Do you have like the tentative boxes that they're going to move already? Like how many boxes?' Typical box count range for size not provided until later when customer reported 30–50 boxes.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Partial. Rep gives a range for a two-bedroom ('three and a half to five and a half hours' initially, later narrowed to 'three and a half to four and a half' based on boxes), but personalizes only to the box count increase, not to prep level or stated concerns. Dollar estimate ($777–$999) eventually provided, but no framing like 'typical budget for a move this size.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Partial. Rep mentions 'we will only charge the customer for the actual hours' and later '$222 per hour for the two movers,' showing rate transparency, but no upfront disclosure of trip fee, overnight fee, or packing materials. The 2.5-hour minimum is mentioned in the confirmation email details (per customer's recap), but not clearly stated by rep during the call itself.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. No 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent checkpoint, and no pause to let the customer react.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: None. No mention of an On-Time Guarantee or any discount if late.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: None. No mention of No Worries Damage Coverage, $2,000 coverage, no-deductible framing, or any damage guarantee.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. No closing question like 'Does that put those to rest?' after (non-existent) Two Promises delivery. The call proceeds directly to booking without confirming the customer feels secure.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep asks 'Will there be anything else Stacy that I can help you with today?' — a throwaway 'anything else' rather than 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: No. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' appears.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. The call ends with 'Will there be anything else... that I can help you with today?' and does not include 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any explicit close.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: No mention of rate lock or deposit policy.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Confirmed: date (Friday, October 2nd), time (1:00 PM), arrival window (12:00 PM–2:00 PM), email (sent confirmation). Missing: actual customer phone number, crew size (two movers mentioned but not confirmed as booked), and notes left for crew about customer's stated concerns (no concerns were raised, so nothing to hand off).

top_strength: Jevic gathered logistics details methodically (property type, floors, walking distance, item list, destinations) and adjusted the estimate in real time when the customer reported 30–50 boxes, showing flexibility and responsiveness.
coaching_note: You skipped the two largest structural gaps: never ask Their Agenda (Section 2), and never deliver the Two Promises (Section 5) or ask for the business explicitly (Section 7)—these three sections together account for 50 points and are non-negotiable on every full sales call.
